Single round, independent private values, winner pays second-highest sealed bid. This is strategically equivalent to a second-price auction. The dominant strategy is to bid my true value: bidding higher risks negative surplus if the second-highest exceeds my value; bidding lower risks losing when winning would be profitable. Therefore, I will bid my value ($47) and exit exactly at that price in the clock stage.
